chunks: From him, from Al-Hasan, from Ja'far ibn Sama'ah, from Adam Bayy al-Lulu, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

When the boy reaches thirteen years, the good deed is written for him, and the evil deed is written against him, and he is punished. And when the girl reaches nine years, so it is like that, and that is because she menstruates at nine years.

key_terms.كُتِبَتْ لَهُ الْحَسَنَةُ: The good deed is written for him

ai.seo_question: What is the age of maturity for boys and girls in Shia Islam according to Al-Kafi?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi establishes the canonical ages of legal maturity (bulugh) in Shia jurisprudence, setting thirteen for boys and nine for girls, thereby initiating the obligation of divine commands (taklif). It explicitly links this legal accountability to the physiological sign of puberty, noting that menstruation typically begins at age nine for girls, which serves as the primary indicator for the onset of religious duties.

en.hubeali:
From him, from Al Hassan, from Ja’far Bin Sama’at, from Adam Baya Al Lulu, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, 
Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> has said:

‘When the boy reaches thirteen years, the good deeds are Written for him, and the evil deeds are Written against him, and Punished. And when the girl reaches nine years, so it is like that, and that is because she menstruates at nine years’.
en.sarwar: 6. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from al-Hassan from Ja‘far ibn Sama‘ah from Adam, Bayya’ al-Lu’lu from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan who has narrated the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

When a boy become thirteen years old his doing good deeds are written for him as well as bad deeds for which he will be punished. When a girl becomes nine years old it also is the same because she experiences Hayd (menses) when she is nine years old.”’
